checks.text: Module bench_dup exists in web/modules/custom/bench_dup and is enabled.
createDuplicate() of a published page "Report" returns an unsaved, unpublished node titled "Report (copy)", and the original keeps its title and status.
Practice: The module does not implement presave or insert hooks for this.
Practice: No procedural hook implementations (legacy-scan oop-hooks rules).
Practice: The module uses no core API that data/drupal/deprecations.json lists as deprecated or removed.

@@ -0,0 +1,5 @@
+name: Bench Duplicate
+type: module
+description: Marks duplicated nodes as "(copy)" and unpublished.
+core_version_requirement: ^10 || ^11
+package: Custom
diff --git a/web/modules/custom/bench_dup/bench_dup.module b/web/modules/custom/bench_dup/bench_dup.module
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..e6444c6
--- /dev/null
+++ b/web/modules/custom/bench_dup/bench_dup.module
@@ -0,0 +1,19 @@
+<?php
+
+/**
+ * @file
+ * Hooks for the Bench Duplicate module.
+ */
+
+use Drupal\node\NodeInterface;
+use Drupal\Core\Entity\EntityInterface;
+
+/**
+ * Implements hook_ENTITY_TYPE_duplicate() for nodes.
+ *
+ * Runs on the copy created by createDuplicate(), before it is saved.
+ */
+function bench_dup_node_duplicate(NodeInterface $duplicate, EntityInterface $entity): void {
+  $duplicate->setTitle($entity->label() . ' (copy)');
+  $duplicate->setUnpublished();
+}
